content: VulkanMemoryAllocator (GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator) is MIT licensed. Latest release v3.4.0 (2026). Single-header-style allocator (vk_mem_alloc.h + small .cpp) for buffer/image memory -- ideal fit for allocating vertex/index buffers and render-target images/textures without hand-writing a memory allocator. Actively maintained by AMD/GPUOpen, ubiquitous in production Vulkan codebases.
